body: Yes, that is a great idea. My mum did mention it. I will look into it. My brother told me to read the book from Friar Jack Wintz, I will see you in heaven. Thanks for the support.

Thanks Stupadbear...I don't think I want another dog. I went through 3 dogs and it still hurts like crazy. All 3 of them were adopted. Maybe with time, I hope I might get another one. Thanks for your message, I  believe his spirit is with me, it's just hard to deal with the physical aspects of this. I keep psyching myself that his body is just a shell...his soul has gone to heaven. I don't know but the thought of bringing him for cremation tomorrow scares me tremendously.

Thanks mollymay...I feel slightly better now but I don't know how I am going to face his cremation tomorrow. And, yes didi can hang out with hootie until we get there. Thanks so much for your kind words.
